# WhileNode

- Namespace/type: `PPDS.Query.Planning.Nodes.WhileNode`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Query`

## Summary

Implements WHILE loop execution. Evaluates the condition before each iteration and executes the body node while the condition is true. Yields any rows produced by the body across all iterations.
